verdict.rationale: Flagsmith's first-party docs state that self-hosting runs the complete platform in your own infrastructure. They document concrete deployment paths: Docker for a full environment, plus Kubernetes/OpenShift with Helm charts and operators. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of self-hosted deployments.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Self-hosting Flagsmith allows you to run the complete Flagsmith platform within your own infrastructure, giving you full control over your data, security policies, and deployment environment.
This guide explains how to run a full Flagsmith environment on your local machine using Docker.
Kubernetes and OpenShift: Full Kubernetes deployment with Helm charts and operators
